# Matbench Discovery plotting reference (v1.1.0)

These unmodified MIT-licensed scripts were retrieved from the `v1.1.0` release
(commit `e7b6efa529bdc309f497003a04b252ef80f6f2a4) of
<https://github.com/janosh/matbench-discovery>. They are retained as a style
reference for the SourceAware-Stability Figure 1 cumulative discovery curves
and Figure 2 density-plus-rolling diagnostic. They are not executed by this
repository and do not supply any data or numerical result.

SourceAware figures use frozen SourceAware data and a separately implemented
Matplotlib renderer. The borrowed visual grammar is explicitly limited to the
line palette/dash semantics, marginal density layout, external legends and
rolling-window callout convention.
